faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to questions about our services and cooperation process

q1.question: How long does project implementation take?
q1.answer: Implementation time depends on project complexity. Simple web applications can be ready in 2-3 months, while more complex systems require 6-12 months. After the audit, we prepare a detailed schedule with specific dates.

q2.question: What technologies do you use?
q2.answer: We work with the latest technologies tailored to project needs. In web applications, we use React, Next.js, TypeScript. In mobile applications, React Native, Flutter, and native iOS and Android solutions. Technology choice is always consulted with the client.

q3.question: Do you provide support after deployment?
q3.answer: Yes, we offer comprehensive technical support after deployment. This includes monitoring, security updates, performance optimization, and adding new features. We can also provide full system maintenance.

q4.question: What does the cooperation process look like?
q4.answer: We start with an audit and needs analysis. Then we create a roadmap with priorities and schedule. During implementation, we regularly present progress and conduct acceptance tests. After deployment, we provide support and maintenance.

q5.question: How much does a project cost?
q5.answer: Project cost depends on its scope, complexity, and requirements. After the audit, we prepare a detailed quote broken down into stages. We also offer flexible cooperation models - from one-time projects to long-term contracts.

q6.question: Can I see examples of your work?
q6.answer: Of course! In the Case Studies section, you'll find detailed descriptions of our projects along with results. We can also organize a presentation of selected solutions during consultation.
